user.title: Ruijie Reyee (Local)
user.description: Connect to your Reyee router (gateway). Add switches afterwards with **+ Add switch** on the router entry.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable.

abort.added_to_router: That IP is a switch, so it was added to your router's Switches group instead of as a separate hub.

user.title: Add switch
user.description: {count} switch(es) found by the router {router}. Pick one from the list, or type an IP into the box. ES PoE switches don't need a password (they're managed through the router). Leave the password empty to use the router's.

data.switch: Switch (pick one or type an IP)

reconfigure.title: Manage switches
reconfigure.description: Tick any switch to remove it from Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach that switch, and the router doesn't know it. Check the IP and password.

abort.switch_added: Switch {host} added. It appears under Switches in a few seconds.
abort.no_group: Restart Home Assistant once, then try again.
abort.no_switches: No switches added yet. Use Add switch.

user.title: Add access points
user.description: {count} access point(s) found by the router {router}. Tick the ones to add. They're read through the router, so no password is needed.

reconfigure.title: Manage access points
reconfigure.description: Tick any AP to remove its extra sensors.

abort.ap_added: Added {count} access point(s). Their sensors appear in a few seconds.
abort.no_new_aps: All access points the router knows are already added.
abort.no_group: Restart Home Assistant once, then try again.
abort.no_aps: No access points added yet. Use Add AP.
